title.v: Phân tích dữ liệu bán hàng

options.query: select id, formname%l from sysreportpivot where (user_id in (0, @@userId) or form_type = 1) and controller = '@@controller' order by user_id, id

request.text: select field from sysrightanalysissale where user_id = @@userId
select '' as message, id, form_type, pivotinfo from sysreportpivot where controller = @controller and id = @id

declare @id int select @id = isnull(max(id), 0) + 1 from sysreportpivot where controller = @controller set @reportForm = rtrim(@id) + @reportForm insert into sysreportpivot(user_id, id, controller, form_type, formname, formname2, pivotinfo, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2) select @@userId, @id, @controller, @form_type, @name, @name2, @reportForm, 1, getdate(), getdate(), @@userId, @@userId select '' as message, 'filter$analysisSalesData$Saved(p, ''' + rtrim(@id) + ''');p.tabActive(''1'');' as script

declare @pid int; set @pid = dbo.sf_GetWordNum(replace(@reportForm, '|', ','), 1) if not exists(select 1 from sysreportpivot where id = @pid and (@@admin = 1 or user_id = @@userId) and controller = @controller) begin select '$ReportPivotNotEdit' as message, 'name' as field return end update sysreportpivot set pivotinfo = @reportForm, formname = @name, formname2 = @name2, form_type = @form_type where id = @pid and user_id = @@userId and controller = @controller select '' as message, 'filter$analysisSalesData$Saved(p, ''' + rtrim(@id) + ''');' as script

loading.text: declare @script nvarchar(4000) exec ISWIFTStoredGetJSLoadingReport '@@folder', '@@controller', @@unit, @@userId, @@admin, @script output select @script + 'p.options._admin = @@admin;' as script
